title: Vision-Grounded Machine Interpreting: Improving the Translation Process through Visual Cues

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating translation accuracy on a hand-crafted diagnostic corpus designed to trigger gender resolution ambiguities (e.g., translating gender-neutral terms like 'doctor' into languages with grammatical gender like 'dottore/dottoressa'). The study compares a speech-only baseline against multimodal models to see if visual cues prevent default gender assumptions and improve gender agreement.
